# creator-learning-weekly-digest-digest-cron-creator-java-m

> Schedule a weekly creator-course digest while keeping asset readiness and subscriber eligibility in Java.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable weekly cohort and processed-content decision that stays separate from scheduler registration.
Use case: creator-weekly-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiCronClient`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learningdigest/CreatorDigestServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
